items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I made a lot of scores for her, and she paid me for all of them. I supervised her recordings, and on one of the sessions, guess who I had playing piano for me, and I was the conductor? Nellie Letcher.

ctx.x: So I had to check my head, you know. It wouldn't come out. So man, it was a lovely thing, and I made a lot of scores for her, and she paid me for all of them. I supervised her recordings, and on one of the sessions, guess who I had playing piano for me, and I was the conductor? Nellie Letcher.
: Oh really? I know Nellie, yeah.
